description: Solve Amazon classic image CAPTCHAs (opt-in) via OCR, input filling, and submission, returning JSON status. Providers: 'amazon-local' (offline OCR; pip install amazoncaptcha), or API providers 'capsolver' / '2captcha' (CAPSOLVER_API_KEY / TWOCAPTCHA_API_KEY). For token CAPTCHAs (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile) use the captcha config/auto CLI.
name: browser_captcha_solve
